areas.name: Political Behavior and Public Opinion
areas.description: How voters judge the economy, assign blame, respond to partisan cues and form preferences over democracy itself.

areas.name: Political Economy of Labor and Social Protection
areas.description: The policy priorities of vulnerable workers, attitudes toward redistribution, and the electoral effects of social policy.

areas.name: Legislatures and Public Policy
